entities.name: Abebech Gobena
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abebech Gobena was an Ethiopian humanitarian, and the founder and manager of AGOHELMA, one of the oldest orphanages in Ethiopia. She was often called the "Mother Teresa of Africa".
